Raven (CV 4)

A large black corvid with an iridescent throat, wedge-shaped tail and keen, curious eyes. It remembers faces and treats unattended food and interesting objects as opportunities.

Attributes: Brawn -2; Fortitude -1; Agility +2; Guile +1; Knowledge -2; Reason +1

HP: 4 · Speed: 2; fly 9 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 0

Evasion: 1 Bane · Threat: 1 Boon · Stability: 0

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: None\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Main ActionsDefenseDamage

Details

Peck

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: Bright objects disappear from an unattended camp.

Purpose: Find food and interesting things without being caught.

Tactics and retreat: Peck only when cornered; take to the air at the first opening.

Counterplay and conversation: A covered food bowl or a glittering trinket buys its attention.

Habitat: Wilderness · Communication: Calls; cannot report human speech verbatim

Loot: A nest may hold one small lost object.

Summoning: Animal 1 — @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.c28570a76a7c7f1f.JournalEntryPage.162883abad92e82a]{player reference}.

Design notes — not needed during play

ID: creature-raven

Category: Animal · Role: Scout · CV: 4

Difficulty rationale: An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Its minor attack is easier to defend, granting a Boon.

Reference damage: 1/1/2

Reference type: physical

Expected targets: 1

Utility factor: 1.1

Regeneration per turn: 0
